tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhas 'jug gi sdom byang bzhugs so//

bzhi bcom drug ldan mtha' las 'das/ /zhi 'jam thugs rje'i dpal ldan pa/ /gzhon nur gyur pa la btud nas/ /mkhas 'jug sdom byang 'dzin chos spel/ /gang la mkhas par bya ba yi/ / gnas bcu dag tu gsungs pa ni/ /phung khams skye mched rten 'brel dang*/ /gnas dang gnas min dbang po dus/ /bden pa dang ni theg pa dang*/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas bcu'o/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang*/ /'du byed rnam shes phung po lnga/ /gzugs ni dbang lnga don lnga dang*/ /chos kyi skye mched gzugs bcas so/ /mig rna sna lce lus dbang lnga/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg don lnga/ /mig yul gzugs kyi dbye ba la/ /sngo ser dkar dmar rtsa ba'i mdog /sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna/ /nyi grib snang mun yan lag brgyad/ /ring thung lham zlum mtho dma' dang*/ /phra rags phyal dang phyal min dbyibs/ /gzhan yang bzang ngan bar ma sogs/ /nang gi dbye ba du mar 'gyur/ /sgra yi nang gi dbye ba la/ /zin 'byung rgyus byung ma byung dang*/ /gnyis ka las ni byung ba gsum/ /sems can du ston don rjod byed/ /de zlog dang gnyis don brjod la/ /'jig rten 'phags pas brtag gnyis dang*/ /gzhan yang bzang ngan bar ma gsum/ /nang gi dbye ba tshad med do/ /dri la zhim mi zhim cha mnyam/ /lhan skyes sbyar byung sogs dbye'o/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska/ /ro ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /gzhan yang yid 'ong mi 'ong dang*/ /bar ma gsum sogs dbye ba mang*/ /reg bya rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis/ /sra gsher dro g.yo rgyu 'byung reg /'jam rtsub lci yang bkres skom grang*/ /mnyen lhod dam tshim na rga 'chi/ /ngal sos pa dang spung che sogs/ /'bras bu'i reg bya'i dbye ba'o/ /chos kyi skye mched pa yi gzugs lnga ni/ /bsdus las gyur dang mngon par skabs yod dang*/ /yang dag blangs pa las byung gzugs dang ni/ /kun brtags pa dang dbang 'byor gzugs lnga'o/

/phra rab rdul dang rdul phran dang*/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*/ /nyi zer sro ma shig nas sor/ /gong nas gong du bdun 'gyur te/ /sor mo nyer bzhi khru gang la/ /khru bzhi gzhu 'dom gang zhes bya/ /gzhu 'dom lnga brgya rgyang grags te/ /rgyang grags brgyad ni dpag tshad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po'i dbye ba la/ /bde dang sdug bsngal btang snyoms gsum/ /bde dang yid bde sdug bsngal dang*/ /yid mi bde dang btang snyoms lnga/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa las/ /byung ba'i tshor ba la sogs drug /de la bde sdug btang snyoms kyi/ /dbye bas tshor ba bco brgyad 'gyur/ /yang ni lus tshor sems tshor gnyis/ /zang zing bcas dang zang zing med/ /zhen pa rten dang nges 'byung rten/ /la sogs dbye bas du mar 'gyur/ /'du shes kyi ni phung po la/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa las/ /byung ba'i 'du shes la sogs drug /don dang tha snyad 'dzin pas gnyis/ /yang ni mtshan bcas mtshan med dang*/ /chung ngu che dang tshad med pa/ /ci yang med pa'i 'du shes drug /de la sogs pa'i dbye ba mdzad/ /'du byed kyi ni phung po la/ /mtshungs ldan mtshungs ldan min gnyis las/ /sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa ni/ /sems byung lnga bcu nga gcig ste/ /tshor 'du sems pa yid byed dang*/ /reg pa lnga ni kun 'gro'o/ /'dun pa mos pa dran pa dang*/ /ting 'dzin shes rab yul nges lnga/ /tshor ba 'du shes gnyis ma gtogs/ /gzhan kun 'du byed phung pos bsdus/ /dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyang*/ /btang snyoms ngo tsha khrel yod dang*/ /ma chags ma sdang gti mug med/ /rnam par mi 'tshe brtson 'grus ni/ /dge ba'i sems byung bcu gcig ste/ /ngo bo dge phyir de 'brela'ang dge/ /ma rig 'dod chags khong khro dang*/ /nga rgyal the tshom lta ba la/ /rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug ces bya/ /lta ba de la lngar phye na/ /'jig tshogs lta dang rtag chad kyi/ /mthar lta dang ni log lta dang*/

/lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa dang*/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin no/ /lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga/ /rtsa ba'i nyon mongs bcu zhes bya/ /khro ba 'khon 'dzin 'tshig pa dang*/ /rnam 'tshe phrag dog g.yo dang sgyu/ /ngo tsha med dang khrel med dang*/ /'chab pa ser sna rgyags pa dang*/ /ma dad pa dang le lo dang*/ /bag med brjed ngas shes bzhin min/ /rmugs pa rgod pa rnam g.yeng bcas/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs nyi shu'o/ /nyon mongs sum cu de dag las/ /'jig mthar gnyis dang de gnyis dang*/ /mtshungs ldan ma rig ma gtogs gzhan/ /'dod khams 'dir ni ngo bo yis/ /mi dge yin phyir de dag dang*/ /'brel ba'i las rnams mi dger 'gyur/ /gnyid dang 'gyod pa rtog dang dpyod/ /gzhan 'gyur bzhi zhes bya ba yin/ /ldan min 'du byed nyer bzhi ni/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang*/ /'du shes med dang de'i snyoms 'jug /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug srog dbang dang*/ /skye gnas rga dang mi rtag dang*/ /ming dang tshig dang yi ge'i tshogs/ /so skye 'jug pa so sor nges/ /'byor 'brel mgyogs pa go rim dus/ /yul dang grangs dang tshogs pa ste/ /'dis mtshon gzhan rnams de ltar shes/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa nas/ yid shes bar gyi tshogs drug dang*/ /nyon mongs can gyi yid dang ni/ /kun gzhi rnam par shes pa bcas/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag tu 'dod/ /'dus byas chos kun phung po lngar/ /'dus phyir de dag gtam gzhi dang*/ /rgyu bcas 'jig rten lta gnas dang*/ /srid pa dag tu'ang brjod pa yin/ /'dun pa dang ni 'dod chags kyi/ /nyer len zag bcas phung po de/ /'thab bcas sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang*/ /nges par 'byung bya dag tu brjod/ /phung lnga'i rab dbye la mkhas na/ /bdag la gcig pur 'dzin pa yi/ /lta ba ngan pa ldog 'gyur zhing*/ /'dus byas chos la mkhas par 'gyur/ /mig dang gzugs dang mig shes khams/

/rna ba sgra dang rna shes khams/ /sna dang dri dang sna shes khams/ /lce dang ro dang lce shes khams/ /lus dang reg bya lus shes khams/ /yid dang chos dang yid shes khams/ /dbang drug yul drug shes drug ste/ /de ltar khams ni bco brgyad do/ /drug po 'das ma thag pa yi/ /rnam shes gang yin de yid dbang*/ /chos khams dbye ba bcu drug ste/ /brtags 'gog brtags min nam mkha' dang*/ /dge sogs de bzhin nyid gsum dang*/ /'du shes med dang 'gog snyoms kyi/ /sems med gnyis te 'dus ma byas/ /rnam pa brgyad dang tshor ba dang*/ /'du shes 'du byed chos kyi ni/ /skye mched gzugs lnga dang bcas so/ /de ltar khams ni bco brgyad du/ /shes bya'i chos kun 'dus pas na/ /de la zag bcas zag med sogs/ /dbye ba'i rnam grangs shes par bya/ /yul drug gzung bya'i rgyu dang ni/ /dbang drug 'dzin dang shes drug gis/ /de 'dzin byed par rtogs pa na/ /bdag rgyur lta ba ldog par 'gyur/ /mig rna sna lce lus yid dang*/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos kyi/ /skye mched dag ni bcu gnyis te/ /mig dang gzugs nas yid chos bar/ /skye mched ces pa'i ming sbyar ro/ /rnam shes khams bdun yid du bsdus/ /yid ni kun gyi yul can te/ /rtog bcas yid kyis chos rnams la/ /rdzas btags snang sel 'gal 'brel dang*/ /yul dang yul can la sogs pa'i/ /tha snyad sna tshogs byas pa yis/ /shes bya'i don la mi rmongs 'gyur/ /yul la snang yul gzung yul dang*/ /zhen yul 'jug yul rnam pa bzhi/ /yul can blo yi dbye ba la/ /snang la ma nges yid dpyod dang*/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom dang*/ /mngon sum rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/ /bcad shes dang ni bdun du dbye/ /blo kun ma rtogs log rtog dang*/ /the tshom yang dag rtogs bzhir 'du/ /sel bar don dang blo'i rnam gnyis/ /rnam gcod dang ni yongs gcod gnyis/ /mi srid mi ldan gzhan ldan gcod/

/don ldog gzhi ldog rang ldog gsum/ /de la sogs pa'i dbye ba yod/ /'gal la lhan cig mi gnas dang*/ /phan tshun spangs 'gal rnam pa gnyis/ /dang por blo 'gal don 'gal gnyis/ /gnyis par dngos 'gal brgyud 'gal gnyis/ /'brel la bdag gcig 'brel ba dang*/ /de byung 'brel ba rnam gnyis so/ /tha snyad rang gi rnam dbye la/ /shes brjod 'jug pa'i tha snyadagasum/ /mthong thos bye brag phyed pa dang*/ /myong ba'i tha snyad rnam pa bzhi/ /yin yod sgrub dang med min dgag /dgag sgrub tha snyad yan lag bzhi/ /chos kun bsdu na snang ba gzugs/ /gtso bo sems dang 'khor sems byung*/ /ldan min 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /shes bya gzhi lnga der 'du 'o/ /phyi yi yul drug longs spyod bya/ /nang gi drug po spyod byed la/ /skye mched de dag sna tshogs pas/ /bdag la za por 'dzin pa ldog /phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ste skye/ /phyi yi rgyu dang 'brel ba ni/ /sa bon myu gu 'dab ma dang*/ /sdong bu sbu gu snying po dang*/ /me tog 'bras bu rim par 'byung*/ /de dang 'brel ba'i rkyen drug ste/ /sa chu me rlung mkha' dus so/ /nang gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ /'di yod pa las 'di 'byung ste/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa/ /tshor ba sred pa len pa dang*/ /srid pa skye ba rga shi 'o/ /ma rig sred len gsum nyon mongs/ /'du byed srid pa gnyis ni las/ /lhag ma bdun po sdug bsngal te/ /bsdu na kun 'byung sdug bsngal gnyis/ /ma rig yod na lugs 'byung du/ /mgal me bskor ltar rgyun mi 'chad/ /ma rig ldog na lugs ldog gi /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis 'grub/ /de dag rkyen drug 'brel ba ste/ /sa chu me rlung mkha' rnam shes/ /rten dmigs snang mkha' yid byed lngas/ /mig shes skye sogs chos rnams kun/ /rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'dus las skye/

/dus dang dbang phyug sogs kyis min/ /kha ton mar me me long rgya/ /me shel sa bon skyur dang sgras/ /phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba ni/ /mi 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya/ /de ltar rten 'brel don rtogs na/ /rtag min chad min 'phos pa'ang min/ /rgyu chung na yang 'bras bu che/ /rgyu 'bras rgyu mthun nyid du shes/ /chos kun rgyu med ma yin la/ /rgyu min gzhan las ma byung ste/ /rten 'brel dbang gis snang bas na/ /bdag la byed por lta ba ldog /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel snang ba kun/ /ma skyes rang bzhin zhi bar mthong*/ /de phyir dus gsum rtogs la mi rmongs shing*/ /'phags lam brgyad ldan chos dang shes bya kun/ /yang dag gzigs pa sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung mthong ba des mthong ngo*/ /gang las gang zhig 'byung ba dang*/ /mi 'byung gnas dang gnas min la/ /rnam par dbye ba tshad med kyang*/ /gzhan dbang bdun gyis mtshon nas bstan/ /mi 'dod 'dod dang rnam dag dang*/ /mnyam du 'byung dang dbang byed dang*/ /'thob pa dang ni kun spyod kyi/ /gzhan dbang rnam pa bdun du brjod/ /gnas dang gnas min shes byed pa'i/ /rig pa'i gnas kyi rnam grangs la/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad ma/ /nang don rig pa gnas chen lnga/ /mngon brjod zlos gar skar rtsis dang*/ /sdeb sbyor snyan ngag gnas chung lnga'o/ /phyi rol tarkal sde lnga ni/ /grangs can bye brag gcer bu pa/ /dpyod pa ba dang rgyang 'phen te/ /bsdus na rtag chad sde gnyis so/ /bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /sems tsam dbu ma grub mtha' bzhi/ /yul dbang shes gsum tshogs pa rkyen/ /des bskyed blo ni rnam bcas te/ /rang rig gzhan rig rnam pa gnyis/ /rtog bcas rtog med la sogs so/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub la/ /mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum zhes bya/ /rgyu 'bras ngo bo nyid dpyad pa'i/ /rdo rje gzegs ma yod med 'gog /gcig dang du bral rnam pa gsum/

/kun dpyod rten 'brel chen mo'o/ /sna tshogs dngos po'i gzhan dbang gis/ /gnas dang gnas min tshul shes na/ /bdag ni kun la dbang sgyur bar/ /'dzin pa'i rmongs pa rab bsal nas/ /shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i/ /shes rab rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni/ /mig rna sna lce lus yid dbang*/ /pho dbang mo dbang srog dbang dang*/ /sdug bsngal dang ni yid mi bde/ /bde dang yid bde btang snyoms dbang*/ /dad brtson dran ting shes rab dbang*/ /kun shes byed dang kun shes pa/ /kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po'o/ /de dag gis ni rang rang gi/ /las la dbang byed rnyed gtong sogs/ /dbang po'i rab tu dbye ba dang*/ /gzhung du bstan pa bzhin shes bya/ /dbang po'i tshul 'di rtogs pa yis/ /bdag ni yul la bdag po ru/ /'dzin pa'i rmongs sogs rab spang nas/ /chos kyi tshul la mkhas par 'gyur/ /'das dang da lta ma 'ongs pa/ /dus ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /de la dus mtha'i skad cig dang*/ /bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig gnyis/ /dus mtha'i skad cig brgya nyi shur/ /de yi skad cig de drug cur/ /thang cig ces bya de sum cur/ /yud tsam gcig ces bya bar brjod/ /yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /zla ba bcu gnyis lo gcig ste/ /lo la dus bzhi drug sogs dbye/ /dbugs drug chu srang zhes bya ste/ /chu srang drug cu chu tshod gcig /chu tshod drug cu nyin zhag gcig /nyin zhag tshes zhag khyim zhag gsum/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi dang*/ /dgun stod dgun smad dpyid sos ka/ /dbyar ston zhes bya dus drug go/ /bskal pa chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi/ /bar bskal dang ni bskal chen gnyis/ /byis gzhon lang tsho dar bab rgud/ /la sogs phyi nang dngos po la/ /ltos te dus kyi rnam gzhag byed/ /dus la mkhas par gyur pa yis/ /dngos kun mi rtag g.yo bar shes/ /bdag la rtag 'dzin rang log nas/

/don dang tha snyad kun shes 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa dang*/ /lam ni bden pa bzhi ru 'dod/ /bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug ni/ /bden pa re la bzhi re ste/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /rgyu dang kun 'byung rab skye rkyen/ /'gog zhi gya nom nges par 'byung*/ /lam rig sgrub pa nges 'byin no/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /ma dag snod kyi 'jig rten ni/ /'og gzhi rlung chu+u sa dkyil gsum/ /ri rab ri bdun mtsho bdun dang*/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang ni/ /so so'i gzhi dang gnas rnams so/ /skye ba'i sems can 'jig rten ni/ /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms dang*/ /ngu 'bod ngu 'bod che tsha ba/ /rab tsha mnar med tsha ba brgyad/ /a chu kyi hud so tham pa/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol/ /pad+ma pad chen ltar gas pa/ /ut+pal ltar gas grang dmyal brgyad/ /shal ma li sdong spu gri'i tshal/ /ro myags 'dam dang thal tshan chu/ /phyogs bzhir bcu drug tsha dmyal gyi/ /nye 'khor gnas zhes bya bar brjod// nyi tshe ba dang bcas pa la/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad ces su brjod/ /yi dwags byings na gnas pa dang*/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i rigs kyi gnyis/ /nang gi las snang myong tshul gyis/ /dbye ba rnam pa mang du yod/ /dud 'gro byings na gnas pa dang*/ /kha thor ba yi rigs gnyis te/ /rkang med rkang gnyis rkang bzhi dang*/ /rkang mang la sogs dbye mtha' yas/ /mi la gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /lus 'phags 'dzam gling la sogs so/ /pho mo ma ning rigs gsum dang*/ /rgyal rigs la sogs dbye ba mang*/ /lha min rgyal po sgra gcan dang*/ /skar phreng mgul phreng thags bzang ris/ /lha min nang gi rigs la ni/ /tshe dpal lha sogs dbye ba yod/ /rgyal chen ris bzhi sum cu gsum/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang*/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed drug po la/ /'dod lha ris drug ces su brjod/

/gzugs khams gnas ris rnam pa bcu bdun ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi ste 'og nas gyen rim gyis/ /dang por tshangs ris mdun 'don tshangs chen gsum/ /gnyis par 'od chung tshad med 'od 'od gsal/ /gsum par dge chung tshad med dge dge rgyas/ /bzhi par sprin med 'od dang bsod nams skyes/ /'bras bu che gsum de steng gnas gtsang lnga/ /mi che mi gdung shin tu mthong ba dang*/ /gya nom snang dang 'og min dang bcas pa/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas ris brgyad yin no/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ /ci yang med dang yod min med min bzhi/ /gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi zhes bya ste/ /de ltar khams gsum srid pa rnam par bzhag /de la skye srid dang ni 'chi srid dang*/ /bar srid sngon dus srid pa rnam bzhir gsungs/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ngan song gsum/ /mi dang lha min lha ste mtho ris gsum/ /de dag bsdoms na 'gro ba rigs drug ste/ /lha min lhar bsdus gzhan lnga rgyud lngar brjod/ /de la yang dag nges pa dang*/ /log par nges dang ma nges pa'i/ /phung po gsum dang sems can ris/ /nang gi dbye ba sna tshogs yod/ /rdzus skyes dang ni drod gsher skyes/ /mngal skyes sgong skyes skye gnas bzhi/ /khams kyi zas dang reg pa'i zas/ /sems pa rnam shes zas bzhi'o/ /zas dang gnyid dang legs bya ba/ /ting 'dzin lus rgyas rgyu bzhi'o/ /skyes mtha' 'chi dang 'dus mtha' 'bral/ /bsags 'dzad mtho lhung mtha' bzhi'o/ /sems can 'jig rten de dag gi/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' tsam brjod/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ /tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang*/ /log lta can dang lkugs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kyis stongs mi khom brgyad/ /mir gyur dbang tshang yul dbus skyes/ /las mtha' ma log dad rang 'byor/ /rgyal byon chos gsungs bstan pa gnas/ /der 'jug bshes zin gzhan 'byor lnga'o/ /mi khom bral ba'i dal brgyad dang*/

/'byor bcu tshang ba chos kyi rten/ /las dang nyon mongs rnam smin gyi/ /sgrib pa rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa dang*/ /skyes bu dam par brten pa dang*/ /bdag nyid legs par smon pa dang*/ /sngon yang bsod nams bgyis rgyu yod/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen tshang bas na/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi zhes gsungs/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa la/ /phun sum tshogs pa sde bzhir brjod/ /tshe ring nad med gzugs bzang dang*/ /skal pa bzang dang rigs mtho ba/ /nor mang ba dang shes rab che/ /'di dag mtho ris yon tan bdun/ /rnyed bde grags bstod 'dod gyur cing*/ /ma rnyed sdug bsngal mi snyan dang*/ /smad pa dag ni mi 'dod pa/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ces su bshad/ /tshe dang dus dang nyon mongs dang*/ /lta dang sems can snyigs ma lnga'o/ /sems can sdug bsngal rnam grangs la/ /tshad med yod kyang mdor bsdu na/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni sdug bsngal dang*/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya dang*/ /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal gsum/ /rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum zhes bya/ /skye rga na 'chi sdug pa 'bral/ /mi 'dod thog bab 'dod mi rnyed/ /nyer len phung lnga sdug bsngal ba/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad du gsungs/ /kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs te/ /thog mar las kyi rnam grangs la/ /snang gyur myong gyur las gnyis dang*/ /de bzhin zag bcas zag med dang*/ /rig byed rig byed min gnyis dang*/ /stobs che ba dang stobs chung gnyis/ /byas la bsags dang ma bsags gnyis/ /'phen byed dang ni rdzogs byed gnyis/ /legs spyad dang ni nyes spyad gnyis/ /sems dang bsam pa'i las gnyis dang*/ /lus ngag yid kyi las gsum dang*/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /bsod nams bsod nams min mi g.yo/ /bde sdug btang snyoms myong 'gyur gsum/ /yon po skyon can snyigs ma gsum/ /dkar dang gnag dang 'dres ma gsum/ /mthong chos dang ni skyes nas dang*/

/lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gsum/ /myong bar ma nges dang bcas bzhi/ /zag bcas las zad zag med nyid/ /sdom dang sdom min bar sdom gsum/ /bar ma'i dge dang mi dge gnyis/ /sdom pa so sor thar pa dang*/ /bsam gtan zag med rnam pa gsum/ /dge slong pha dang dge slong ma/ /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma/ /dge bsnyen pha ma bsnyen gnas ni/ /so sor thar pa rigs brgyad do/ /bsam gtan bsam gzugs ting 'dzin las/ /zag med 'phags lam thob pa'o/ /dge sogs gsum po gang la yang*/ /ngo bo nyid dang mtshungs ldan dang*/ /rjes 'brel slong ba don dam sogs/ /dbye ba'i rnam grangs gzhung du blta/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsgoms las byung*/ /bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta gsum/ /tshig rtsub phra ma ngag kyal rdzun/ /srog gcod ma byin len log g.yem/ /mi dge ba ni bcu yin te/ /de spangs pa ni dge ba bcu/ /srog skyabs la sogs khyad par can/ /rnam smin dang ni byed pa dang*/ /myong ba rgyu mthun bdag 'bras dang*/ /skyes bu byed 'bras dang bcas lngas/ /las kyi 'bras bu 'byung tshul bshad/ /pha ma dgra bcom gsod pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku la khrag 'byin dang*/ /dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen byed pa/ /mtshams med pa yi las lnga'o/ /ma dgra bcom ma sun byas dang*/ /byang sems nges gnas bkum pa dang*/ /'phags pa slob pa gsod pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog pa/ /mchod rten 'jig par byed pa lnga/ /nye ba'i mtshams med ces su bshad/ /bde gshegs mchod rten byed pa dang*/ /dge 'dun sde la gtsug lag phul/ /dge 'dun dbye ba bsdum pa dang*/ /byams bsgom tshangs pa'i bsod nams bzhi'o/ /de sogs dge dang mi dge'i las/ /rnam grangs mang po mdo las shes/ /nyon mongs pa yi rnam grangs la/ /gang gis skye ba'i rgyu bshad pa/ /phra rgyas spangs pa ma yin dang*/ /yul ni nye bar gnas pa dang*/

tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed gsum/ /tshogs pa las ni nyon mongs skye/ /gang gis 'khor bar zag byed pa/ /nyon mongs rnams yin de dag ni/ /gang la 'phrod cing rgyas rung ba/ /de dag zag bcas chos zhes gsung*/ /rtsa ba'i nyon mongs rnam drug las/ /lta dang the tshom ma rig pas/ /rang ris kun dang gong mar dmigs/ /de phyir kun 'gro zhes bya ste/ /de yang sdug bsngal mthong spang gi/ /lta ba lnga dang the tshom dang*/ /kun bden mthong bas spang bya ba'i/ /log lta lta ba the tshom gsum/ /de rnams mtshungs ldan ma rig dang*/ /ma 'dres pa yi ma rig ste/ /bcu gcig de la kun 'gro zhes/ /rang gi ris kyi spang bya ni/ /lnga char kun la rgyas pa yin/ /de las 'jig mthar gnyis ma gtogs/ /dgu pos gong ma'i sa la'ang dmigs/ /'gog lam mthong bas spang bya ba'i/ /log lta gnyis dang the tshom gnyis/ /de rnams mtshungs ldan ma rig dang*/ /ma 'dres pa yi ma rig drug /zag med la yang dmigs pa yin/ /'on kyang rgyas par mi 'gyur te/ /bdag gir ma byas gnyen po'i phyir/ /kun 'gro min rnams rang ris kyi/ /spang bya lnga po gang de la'o/ /nyon mongs de rnams sems sems byung*/ /gang la mtshungs ldan de la rgyas/ /zag pa'i ngo bo nyon mongs rnams/ /de 'brel sems dang sems byung tshogs/ /de'i rten mig sogs mtshungs ldan rten/ /zag bcas dge yang zag pas bcings/ /zag dang rjes 'brel gnas ngan len/ /'phrod cing dmigs rgyas rjes mthun te/ /zag pa'i sgo drug dang 'brel bas/ /'di rnams zag bcas chos zhes bya/ /rjes chags khong khro nga rgyal dang*/ /ma rig lta ba mchog 'dzin dang*/ /the tshom phrag dog ser sna la/ /kun tu sbyor ba dgu zhes bshad/ /'dod la 'dun dang gnod sems dang*/ /'jig tshogs lta dang the tshom dang*/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin ni/ /tha ma'i cha mthun kun sbyor lnga/ /'jig lta tshul brtul mchog 'dzin dang*/

/the tshom kun sbyor gsum du gsungs*/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'dod chags gnyis/ /rgod pa dang ni rmongs pa dang*/ /nga rgyal gyi ni kun sbyor la/ /gong ma'i cha mthun lnga zhes gsungs/ /sgyu g.yo rgyags dang 'tshig pa dang*/ /'khon 'dzin rnam 'tshe dri ma drug /'dod dang srid chags khong khro nga rgyal dang*/ /ma rig lta ba the tshom bag nyal bdun/ /rmugs gnyid rgod 'gyod phrag dog ser sna dang*/ /ngo tsha med dang khrel med kun dkris brgyad/ /'dod pa dang ni srid pa lta ba dang*/ /ma rig pa yi chu bo rnam pa bzhi/ /'dod dang lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*/ /bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa bzhi/ /brnab sems gnod sems tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*/ /bden par mngon zhen lus kyi mdud pa bzhi/ /'dod la 'dun dang gnod sems rmugs gnyid gnyis/ /rgod 'gyod gnyis dang the tshom sgrib pa lnga/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang gti mug la/ /'chi ba tha ba dri ma sogs su gsungs/ /'dod pa srid pa ma rig zag pa gsum/ /'dod srid ma rig lta ba'i chu sbyor bzhi/ /'dod srid lta dang tshul brtul nyer len bzhi/ /bden bzhi mthong bas spang bya brgya bcu gnyis/ /sgom lam dgus spang bzhi brgya bcu bzhir 'dod/ /sun 'byin pa dang spong ba dang*/ /gzhi dang thag bsring gnyen po bzhi/ /'dod pa'i khams dang khams gong ma'i/ /sdug kun dang ni 'gog lam gyi/ /spang bya zad pa'i yongs shes drug /tha ma'i cha mthun spang ba dang*/ /gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa dang*/ /zag pa kun zad yongs shes dgu'o/ /'gog pa rdzogs dang ma rdzogs dang*/ /brda dang don dam 'gog pa dang*/ /dgra bcom rgyan bcas rgyan med dang*/ /lhag bcas lhag med rnam gnyis so/ /dgra bcom de yi yon tan cha/ /rig pa gsum dang grol ba gnyis/ /mngon shes drug dang shes pa bcu/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang ting 'dzin gsum/ /rnam thar brgyad dang zil gnon brgyad/ /mi slob chos bcu zad par bcu/

/nyon mongs med dang smon nas shes/ /zag med phung po lnga ldan no/ /lam bden zhes pa lam lnga ste/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam/ /tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum dang*/ /sbyor lam drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi/ /chos nyid bden mthong mthong lam gyi/ /ye shes skad cig bcu drug ni/ /sdug bsngal chos bzod chos shes dang*/ /rjes bzod rjes su shes pa bzhi/ /de bzhin kun 'byung 'gog lam gyi/ /bzhi ste bcu drug dag tu 'dod/ /sgom lam sa dgur phye ba ni/ /'dod dang bsam gtan gzugs med bzhi'o/ /bsam gzugs ting 'dzin sgrub pa la/ /yid la byed pa rnam bdun ni/ /mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa dang*/ /mos pa las byung dben las byung*/ /dga' ba sdud dang dpyod pa dang*/ /sbyor mtha' sbyor 'bras yid byed pa'o/ /bsam gtan so so'i dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ /thob pa'i tshe na de yi yan lag ni/ /dang por rtog dpyod dga' bde sems gnas lnga/ /gnyis par rab dwang dga' bde ting 'dzin bzhi/ /gsum par btang snyoms dran shes bde gnas lnga/ /bzhi par 'du byed tshor ba btang snyoms gnyis dran ting 'dzin bzhi/ /rtog dpyod 'byin rngub bde gnyis sdug bsngal gnyis/ /skyon brgyad bral ba bzhi pa'i snyoms 'jug go/ /sred lta nga rgyal ma rig bzhis bslad pa'i/ /snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can de de bral dag /rgyu dang 'bras bu skye ba'i snyoms 'jug gnyis/ /zag bcas zag med spel dang ma spel dbye/ /nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med pa dang*/ /dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam khyad gnyis/ /bsam gtan phyi ma gsum bcas pa/ /bsam gtan sa drug dag tu 'dod/ /de steng gzugs med snga ma gsum/ /bsnan na bsam gtan sa dgu yin/ /sbyor dang bar chad med rnam grol/ /khyad par lam zhes bzhi ru bshad/ /mngon shes myur bul lam dka' sla/ /phan tshun sbyar ba bzhir yang yod/ /brnab sems gnod sems med pa dang*/ /dran dang ting 'dzin chos gnas bzhi/

/zhi lhag thob tshul mu bzhi dang*/ /kun shes byed sogs lam gzhan dag /sdud la dbang byed lam zhes sogs/ /lam gyi rnam dbye sna tshogs yod/ /sbyor ba gang gi mjug thogs su/ /bar chad med lam rdor ting gis/ /sgrib pa spangs pa'i rnam grol lam/ /mthar phyin mi slob lam yin no/ /de tshe zad dang mi skye shes/ /mi slob chos bcu dang ldan te/ /'phags lam brgyad dang rnam grol dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong bcas so/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam par grol dang rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes mthong ba'i phung po la/ /zag med phung po lnga zhes bya/ /de ltar lam dang de thob pa'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' brjod pa/ /nyon mongs phung po 'chi bdag dang*/ /lha'i bu'i bdud bzhi bcom rgyal ba/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang*/ /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa la/ /legs pa'am skal pa drug ces bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ /gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran/ /rang byung 'dus ma byas lhun grub/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /rang gzhan don gnyis grub pa yi/ /yon tan brgyad ldan sangs rgyas nyid/ /lam ni dag gsal gnyen po nyid/ /'gog pa bsam med gnyis med zhi/ /chags bral 'gog lam rtogs pa'i chos/ /de yang yon tan brgyad ldan no/ /rtogs pa'i chos de brjod bya ru/ /byed pa'i gsung rab lung gi chos/ /chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum dge/ /don dang tshig 'bru bzang ba gnyis/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs yongs su dag /yongs byang tshangs spyod bzhi ldan no/ /theg chen 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni/ /ji lta ji snyed so sor rig /chags thogs dman pa'i sgrib las grol/ /rig grol yon tan brgyad ldan pa'o/ /dad gtong tshul khrims thos pa dang*/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang*/ /shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun zhes bya'o/ /sha dang lha dang chos dang ni/

/shes rab ye shes spyan lnga'o/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /gzungs ni byang sems rgyan lnga'o/ /sangs rgyas mchod dang dam chos 'dzin/ /lus kun ston dang zhing kun 'jug /phar phyin rdzogs dang sems can smin/ /zhing sbyang spyod yul mthun par gnas/ /spyod kun don yod byang chen 'thob/ /byang sems smon lam chen po bcu'o/ /sems can 'jig rten nam mkha' chos/ /myang 'das sangs rgyas de'i ye shes/ /sems dmigs sangs rgyas spyod yul dang*/ /'jig rten chos dang ye shes rgyud/ /mtha' la thug med gnas bcu'o/ /de srid snyed du smon sgrub pa'o/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal bsal snyam dang*/ /de bzhin 'byor par 'jog snyam dang*/ /lus kyis gzhan don byar 'dod dang*/ /dmyal gnas gzhan la phan 'dogs 'dod/ /skye 'byor gzhan phan ched 'dod dang*/ /bdag gzhan bde sdug brje 'dod dang*/ /'gro kun re ba rdzogs bya dang*/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas 'gyur snyam pa/ /'di dag skyes bu chen po yi/ /rnam rtog rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /klog pa thos bsam spong bsam gtan/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gsum/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang*/ /mi sdug 'chi ba snang ba dang*/ /chags bral mi 'phrod mngon mi dga'/ /'gog pa'i 'du shes rnam pa bcu/ /nyan thos rnams kyis rgyun du yang*/ /brten par bya ba nyid du gsungs/ /stong nyid mtshan med smon med kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rnam pa gsum/ /'dod chags spong dang shes rab thob/ /mthong chos bde bar gnas pa dang*/ /ye shes mthong ba thob pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni bzhir gsungs so/ /spyos la slar mi spyo ba dang*/ de bzhin brdeg dang gshe ba dang*/ /khros la slar mi khro ba ni/ /dge sbyong dag gi chos bzhir gsungs/ /skra spu so sen rdul dri ma/ /bshang gci mchil snabs mchil rgyus pa/ /pags sha khrag rus tshil rkang rtsa/ /glo snying mchin mtsher mkhal ma dang*/ /pho long rgyu ma gnye ma lgang*/

/zhag dang chu ser rnag bad kan/ /mkhris pa klad pa klad rgyas te/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni so drug go/ /rnam par bam dang 'bus gzhig dang*/ /dmar dang sngo dang gnag pa dang*/ /zos dang 'thor dang tshig dang rul/ /mi sdug pa yi 'du shes dgu/ /keng rus kyi ni rnam par yang*/ spro zhing bsdu dmigs 'dod chags sbyong*/ /phyogs gcig dang ni mtha' dag dang*/ /rtogs gnon spang ba'i chags bral lnga/ /ngo bo nyid dang gnod nyer brtan/ /phul byung rmongs dang gnyen pos dang*/ /yongs shes spang dang gong mar bcas/ /gong na med pa'i chags bral bcu'o/ /pha ma spun sring bu bu mo/ /gnyen dang gnyen mtshams bshes grogs kyi/ /tshul du byams pa'i sems bzhag ste/ /byams pa'i sems kyis kun khyab bya/ /des ni bdag gam mdza' la 'dis/ /dus gsum gnod snyam drug dang ni/ /dgra la phan btags gsum tshul gyi/ /mnar sems dgus byung zhe sdang zhi/ /lha mi byams dang mi min rnams kyang srung*/ /lus sems bde mang dug dang mtshon mi tshugs/ /'bad med don thob tshangs gnas skye ba ste/ /byams chos yon tan brgyad ldan thob par 'gyur/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don bsgoms na/ /gti mug mun sel shes rab snang ba thob/ /lus sems khams kyi tshogs pa rab dbye nas/ /so sor brtag bsgom nga rgyal zhi bar byed/ /nga rgyal che ba'i nga rgyal dang*/ /nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal dang*/ /nga'o snyam dang mngon nga rgyal/ /cung zad snyam dang log nga rgyal/ /nga rgyal rnam pa bdun po dag /rab tu zhi phyir goms par bya/ /rnam par rtog pa shas che ba'i/ /gnyen po 'byin rngub dran pa drug /bgrang dang rjes 'gro 'jog pa dang*/ /nyer rtog sgyur dang yongs dag go/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /bden bzhi'i don la mkhas pa des/ /kun nyon rnam byang don shes pas/ /bdag ni kun nas nyon mongs dang*/ /rnam byang gnas su lta ba ldog

/gang gis 'khor bar 'jug 'gyur la/ /gang zhig gis ni ldog pa dang*/ /ji ltar snang dang ji ltar gnas/ /ma lus bden don mthong bar 'gyur/ /theg pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang*/ /bsdu na theg pa rnam lngar gsungs/ /lha mi'i theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /nyan rang byang sems theg pa'o/ /snga ma gnyis po mngon mtho dang*/ /phyi ma gsum ni nges legs theg /nyan rang gnyis ni theg dman dang*/ /byang sems theg pa theg chen no/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong*/ /dgra bcom nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi/ /de dag zhugs gnas sogs dbye bas/ /dge 'dun nyi shur 'gyur ba yin/ /chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob shes/ /gzhan sems sdug kun 'gog lam shes/ /zad shes mi skye shes pa la/ /shes pa bcu zhes bshad pa yin/ /slob dpon med par rang nyid kyis/ /rten 'brel 'byung ldog don mthong nas/ /bden pa bzhi rtogs bdag med ni/ /phyed gnyis rtogs pa rang sangs rgyas/ /dmigs pa che dang sgrub pa dang*/ /ye shes brtson 'grus thabs mkhas dang*/ /yang dag 'grub dang phrin las che/ /chen po bdun ldan theg chen no/ /sgrub pa dmigs pa yang dag 'grub/ /bla med gsum gyis kyang 'phags so/ /sems dang spangs rtogs chen po gsum/ /ched du byas nas dmigs pa dang*/ /go cha 'jug pa tshogs chen pos/ /chen po gsum dang mnyam nyid dang*/ /sems can don dang 'bad med dang*/ /mtha' 'das kun thob kun mngon mkhyen/ /rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyis/ /nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad ldan 'bras/ /theg chen lam ni mdor bsdu na/ /mi zad pa ni brgyad cur gsungs/ /'dun bsam sbyor ba lhag bsam bzhi/ /phar phyin drug dang tshad med bzhi/ /mngon shes lnga dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /yang dag rig bzhi rton pa bzhi/ /tshogs gnyis byang phyogs sum cu bdun/ /zhi lhag gnyis dang gzungs spobs gnyis/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi gcig bgrod lam/ /thabs mkhas dang bcas brgyad cu'o/

/sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab phar phyin drug /thabs stobs smon lam ye shes bzhi/ /bsnan pas pha rol phyin bcur bzhed/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*/ /btang snyoms dag ni tshad med bzhi/ /lha yi mig dang rna ba dang*/ /gzhan sems shes dang sngon gnas shes/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni mngon shes lnga/ /zag zad mngon shes bsnan drug go/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /don spyod don mthun bsdu dngos bzhi/ /don chos nges pa'i tshig spobs pa/ /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ /gang zag dag la mi rton chos nyid rton/ /tshig la mi rton don la rton pa dang*/ /drang ba'i don la mi rton nges don rton/ /rnam par shes la mi rton ye shes rton/ /rton pa bzhi 'dis lung dang rtogs chos la/ /chud mi za bar dgongs pa'i don rtogs byed/ /bsod nams dang ni ye shes tshogs gnyis po/ /zung 'jug lam gyis don kun yongs rdzogs byed/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams la/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /'di bzhi ngo bo shes rab ste/ /yang dag don ni mthong byed pa'o/ /dge ba skyed dang spel ba dang*/ /mi dge zhi dang mi skye phyir/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi yis ni*/ /brtson 'grus rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dun brtson sems pa dpyod pa ni/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi yin no/ /'di bzhi ngo bo ting 'dzin te/ /gus 'bad sems gnas dpyod shes so/ /dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa dang*/ /ting 'dzin shes rab dbang stobs lnga/ /dran dang chos rab rnam 'byed dang*/ /brtson 'grus dga' dang shin tu sbyang*/ /ting nge 'dzin dang btang snyoms ni/ /byang chub yan lag bdun yin no/ /yang dag lta dang rtog pa dang*/ /ngag dang las mtha' 'tsho ba dang*/ /rtsol ba dran pa ting nge 'dzin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad du brjod/ /nyes pa lnga spangs 'du byed brgyad/ /brten pa'i rgyus byung zhi gnas te/ /le lo dang ni gdams ngag brjed/

/bying rgod 'du mi byed 'du byed/ /lnga ni nyes pa'o de spong byed/ /dad 'dun rtsol ba shin sbyang dang*/ /dran pa shes bzhin sems pa dang*/ /btang snyoms 'du byed brgyad yin no/ /'jog dang rgyun 'jog blan te 'jog/ /nyer 'jog dul byed zhi bar byed/ /rnam zhi rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /sems gnas pa yi thabs dgu'o/ /thos pa bsam pa dran shes bzhin/ /brtson 'grus yongs su 'dris stobs drug /bsgrim 'jug chad 'jug chad med 'jug /rtsol ba med 'jug yid byed bzhi'o/ /lus sems shin tu sbyangs thob nas/ /zhi gnas thob pas g.yeng ba spong*/ /ngo bo nyid dang phyi dang nang*/ /mtshan ma gnas ngan len dang ni/ /chung ngu'i sems kyis g.yeng ba drug /legs spang zhi gnas mchog brten nas/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed chos/ /'byed dang rab tu 'byed pa dang*/ /yongs su rtog dang dpyod pa yi/ /lhag mthong shes rab bsgrub par bya/ /mi brjed pa yi gzungs la ni/ /bzod thob sgo dang tshig dang don/ /sngags kyi gzungs zhes rnam bzhir brjod/ /yang ni gzungs kyi rnam grangs la/ /rnam smin thos dang ting 'dzin skyes/ /so skye sa bdun dag sa pa'i/ /gzungs la chung 'bring chen por bshad/ /yang ni gzungs kyi rnam grangs la/ /sgra dbyangs rnam par dag pa'i gzungs/ /mi zad za ma tog gi gzungs/ /de bzhin 'khyil ba mtha' yas dang*/ /rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya pad+ma bkod/ /chags med snyoms 'jug gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs gzungs brgyad gsungs/ /mi 'jigs pa yi spobs pa ni/ /ji lta ji snyed gnas rnams la/ /myur gsal rno zhing zab rgya che/ /rgyun chad med par spobs pa ste/ /dran blo rtogs pa'i rgyu las byung*/ /gzungs kyis grogs byas spobs pa'i mchog /chos 'dzin byang chub sems ldan zhing*/ /bzod pa thob par byed pa'o/ /'du byed thams cad mi rtag cing*/ /zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ /chos rnams stong zhing bdag med de/

/myang 'das zhi ba sdom bzhi'o/ /mnyam pa nyid la zhugs pa ni/ /bgrod gcig lam ste gcig bgrod kyang ngo*/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs dang mngon shes myur/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs mi gcod/ /thabs shes zung 'jug thams cad kun/ /lam gyi grogs gyur thabs mkhas so/ /de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*/ /de bzhin sems ni skyed pa dang*/ /sbyin la sogs pa sgrub pa dang*/ /skyon med pa la 'jug pa dang*/ /sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang*/ /zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang*/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ /byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o/ /rigs ni bde gshegs snying po ste/ /sku dang ye shes dbyer med dbyings/ /rang byung ye shes 'dus ma byas/ /kun khyab 'pho 'gyur med pa'o/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chos nyid de/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbubs zhugs pa/ /sa 'og gter la sogs pa yi/ /dpe dgus mtshon nas shes par bya/ /chos la khong khro bdag lta dang*/ /'khor bas 'jigs dang sems can 'dor/ /rigs kyi dri ma bzhi yin la/ /de dag spong bar byed pa ni/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab dang*/ /ting 'dzin snying brtse bzhi yin no/ /rang bzhin gnas dang rgyas 'gyur rigs/ /sad pas chos la mos pa 'byung*/ /de yis phyi yi yongs 'dzin las/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa yi/ /sher phyin gdams ngag legs nos nas/ /nang gi yongs 'dzin ldan par bya/ /sems bskyed ldan pas sbyin sogs bsgrub/ /de ni sa la zhugs gyur nas/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid zhing dag sbyor/ /thabs mkhas sbyor bas rdzogs smin sbyangs/ /de nas byang chub mchog thob nas/ /phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/

/theg pa chen po'i lam lnga po/ /dran nye spong bzhi rkang pa bzhis/ /tshogs kyi lam gsum bgrod gyur nas/ /dbang stobs gnyis kyis sbyor lam bgrod/ /byang chub yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /mthong lam rab dga'i sa thob nas/ /'jigs pa lnga bral yon tan ni/ /brgya phrag bcu gnyis dag kyang thob/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad ldan pas/ /sgom lam sa dgur rim pa bzhin/ /dri med 'od byed 'od 'phro dang*/ /sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song*/ /mi g.yo legs blo chos kyi sprin/ /slob pa'i sa ni bcu po la/ /sgrib pa gnyis po rim spangs nas/ /sa rnams yongs su sbyong bar brtson/ /ji lta ji snyed ye shes ni/ /gong 'phel sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' la/ /chos kun snang la mnyam pa yi/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin las/ /mi slob lam gyur sa bcu gcig /kun du 'od ni rab thob ste/ /de bzhin nyid du chos thams cad/ /gnas gyur yon tan mthar thug thob/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas sa de ni/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yis bsdus/ /ngo bo nyid dang chos sku dang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku bzhi'o/ /dag pa gnyis ldan zag med dbyings/ /gzhi rigs mngon gyur ngo bo nyid/ /de yi mkhyen cha chos kyi sku/ /zag med yon tan nyer gcig ldan/ /dag pa'i gdul byar snang ba yi/ /gzugs sku mthar thug longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas dang sku dang 'khor dang chos/ /dus te nges pa lnga ldan no/ /chos kyi dbyings dang me long lta bu dang*/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog pa dang*/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sku ni bsam mi khyab/ /byang phyogs tshad med rnam thar snyoms 'jug dang*/ /zil gnon zad par nyon mongs med smon mkhyen/ /mngon shes yang dag rig bzhi dag pa bzhi/ /dbang bcu stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam pa bzhi/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad bsrung med dran nyer gsum/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' bag chags yang dag bcom/

/thugs rje che dang rnam kun mkhyen nyid de/ /zag med sde tshan nyer gcig nyid du 'dod/ /gzugs can gzugs la lta ba dang*/ /gzugs med gzugs la lta ba dang*/ /sdug pa'i rnam par thar pa dang*/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs bzhi/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang bcas pa/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yin no/ /nang gi gzugs su 'du shes pas/ /che chung dbyibs ni zil gnon gnyis/ /nang gzugs med pas de bzhin gnyis/ /sngo ser dkar dmar zil gnon brgyad/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang*/ /sngo ser dkar dmar rnam shes kyis/ /kun du khyab par byed pa yi/ /zad par dag ni bcu yin no/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /'gog snyoms dang bcas snyoms 'jug dgu/ /gnas dang gnas min rnam smin khams/ /mos dang dbang po bsam gtan dang*/ /lam dang sngon gnas 'chi 'pho dang*/ /zag pa zad mkhyen stobs bcu'o/ /tshe dang sems dang yo byad dang*/ /las dang skye ba mos pa dang*/ /smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes dang*/ /chos la dbang ba dbang bcu'o/ /lus dang dmigs pa sems ye shes/ /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi'o/ /rtogs dang spangs pa lam dang gegs/ /ston la mi 'jigs rnam pa bzhi/ /'khrul dang ca co dran pa nyams/ /mnyam bzhag min dang 'du shes tshogs/ /ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' ba/ /spyod pas bsdus pa drug yin no/ /'dun brtson dran dang shes rab dang*/ /rnam par grol dang rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes gzigs pa nyams pa dag /mi mnga' rtogs pas bsdus pa drug /sku gsung thugs kyi las gsum po/ /ye shes rjes 'brang spyod pa gsum/ /'das dang da lta ma 'ongs par/ /ye shes gzigs 'jug dus bsdus gsum/ /de ltar drug tshan gsum po ni/ /ma 'dres pa ni bco brgyad do/ /chos nyan mi nyan gnyis bcas la/ /chags sdang gnyis med dran nyer gsum/ /sku gsung thugs la nyes spangs pas/ /bcab tu med pa bsrung med gsum/ /phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang zhabs mthil mnyam/

/rting pa 'phags pa'i zhabs yangs 'bur mi mngon/ /byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /phyag zhabs sor mo ring zhing drwa bas 'brel/ /ba spu re rer g.yas phyogs gyen du skyes/ /pags pa gser mdog srab la 'jam pa dang*/ /dpung pa'i mgo zlum ro stod seṅge 'dra/ /phyag zhabs gzhon 'jam sku yi gnas bdun mtho/ /'gram pa zlum rgyas ljags ring ro mchog snang*/ /tshems dkar tshad mnyam thags bzang bzhi bcur ldan/ /mthon mthing spyan mdzes khyu mchog rdzi 'dra ba/ /thal gong rgyas bcas sku ni che zhing drang*/ /chu zheng gab sku gsang ba sbubs su nub/ /mdzod spus mdzes shing gtsug tor bltar mi mngon/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gang mthong dga' skyed skyes bu chen por mtshon/ /sen mo zangs mdog mdog snum mtho ba dang*/ /sor mo zlum la rgyas shing byin gyi phra/ /rtsa rnams mi mngon rtsa yi mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam gom pa snyoms/ /seng ge glang chen khyu mchog ngang pa'i 'gros/ /drang dang g.yas phyogs mdzes par gshegs pa dang*/ /dbu zlum skra mtshams legs 'byes dpral dbyes rgyas/ /dbu skra gnag cing stug la 'jam pa dang*/ /ma 'dzing mi gshor mchog tu dri zhim ldan/ /ut+pal 'dab 'dra dkar nag 'byed pa'i spyan/ /ra ri med cing gzigs pa rnam par dag /rdzi ma stug cing smin tshugs ring ba dang*/ /spu 'jam mdog snum spu rnams ring thung mnyam/ /snyan gnyis tshad mnyam nyams pa rnam par spangs/ /shangs kyi gzengs mtho yongs su dag pa nyid/ /zhal dkyil 'tshams mdzes bim pa lta bu'i mchu/ /pad+ma ltar mnyen srab la dmar ba'i ljags/ /mche ba bzhi zlum rtse rno mdog dkar zhing*/ /ring thung tshad mnyam byin gyis phra zhing mdzes/ /'brug sgra ltar brjid mnyen 'jam ldan pa'i gsung*/ /phyag ring rgyas shing shing bal 'dab ltar 'jam/ /phyag ris mdangs yod zab cing ring du dod/ /'khril bag chags pa rim par 'tshams pa'i sku/

/cha shas kun rdzogs kho lag yangs shing bzang*/ /'jam zhing gzhon sha can gyur zhum med rgyas/ /shin tu grims ldan yan lag rnam par 'byes/ /sme ba gnag bag med cing skyon gyis dag /dri mas gtsang zhing byi dor byas pa 'dra/ /dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyong phyang nge ba/ /lte ba gting zab ri mo g.yas su 'khyil/ /kun spyod gtsang zhing kun nas lta na sdug /bkra shis ri mos mtshan zhing kun yid 'phrog /de dag thub chen dpe byad brgyad cu ste/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyis bsngags 'os nyid/ /mnyen 'jam yid 'ong yid 'thad dag dri med/ /gsal la snyan 'jebs mnyan 'os mi tshugs pa/ /snyan zhing 'dul ba mi rtsub mi brlang zhing/ /rab dul rnar snyan lus dang sems tshim byed/ /snying dga' bde skyid gdung med kun shes pa/ /rnam par rig bya rnam gsal dga' bar byed/ /mngon dga' kun shes rnam par rig par byed/ /rigs pa dang ni 'brel dang ma zlos pa/ /seng ge glang chen 'brug dang klu'i dbang po/ /dri za ka la piṅka tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /shang shang te'u lha dbang rnga sgra'i dbyangs/ /ma khengs mi dma' sgra kun rjes su zhugs/ /sgra zur ma chag ma tshang med pa dang*/ /mi zhum mi zhan rab dga' khyab pa dang*/ /tha ba med dang rgyun chags 'bel ba dang*/ /sgra kun rdzogs byed dbang po tshim par byed/ /ma smad mi 'gyur ma rtabs 'khor kun grags/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa ni/ /thub mchog gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ste/ /chags sdang rmongs dang bdud rnams 'joms byed pa'o/ /srid pa ji srid 'gro la phan bde'i tshul/ /mnyam par mdzad pa sprul pa'i sku la ni/ /byang chub che dang bzo dang skye ba dang*/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i tshul bzhi'o/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rtag khyab lhun grub ste/ /rnam par mi rtog bzhin du 'gog med snang*/ /gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang*/ /tshangs nyi yid bzhin rin chen nor rgyal bzhin/

/sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don mdzad de rnal 'byor rig /gang zhig theg pa la mkhas na/ /theg pa nyid las rnal 'byor du/ /byed phyir bdag ni rnal 'byor can/ /snyoms pa'i lta sogs rmongs kun sel/ /bdag med rten 'brel lam gyi ni/ /theg pa 'di la rab zhugs pa/ /thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /'bras bu bla na med pa thob/ /'dus byas rgyus byung skye 'gag can/ /'dus ma byas ni de las ldog /'dus byas phung po lngas bsdus pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang*/ /skal mnyam dang ni mtshungs ldan dang*/ /kun du 'gro dang rnam smin te/ /rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /rnam smin 'bras dang bdag po dang*/ /rgyu mthun skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras/ /bral ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba/ /'bras bu lnga yi rnam grangs so/ /rgyu rkyen mtshungs pa de ma thag /dmigs rkyen bdag rkyen rkyen bzhi'o/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rnam grangs la/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang*/ /glo bur bral dag rnam pa gnyis/ /de bzhin dri bcas dri med gnyis/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med gnyis/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i de nyid gsum/ /stong nyid mtshan med smon med gsum/ /phyi dang nang dang phyi nang stong*/ /stong pa nyid ni stong nyid dang*/ /chen po stong pa nyid dang ni/ /don dam stong dang 'dus byas stong*/ /'dus ma byas stong mtha' 'das stong*/ /thog mtha' med stong dor med stong*/ /rang bzhin stong dang chos thams cad/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa dang*/ /mi dmigs pa ni stong nyid dang*/ /dngos med ngo bo nyid stong nyid/ /de ltar stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ /slar yang bsdus te bzhir bstan pa/ /dngos po stong pa nyid dang ni/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid/ /ngo bo nyid ni stong pa nyid/ /gzhan gyi dngos po stong nyid do/ /don dam rtogs tshul rim pa las/

/rnam grangs rnam grangs min gnyis so/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs tshul gyi/ /zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang*/ /shes dang dpyod dang gnyis med dang*/ /thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid/ /'dus byas zag pa zad pa las/ /thar pa 'dus ma byas thob phyir/ /bdag ni grol dang ma grol ba'i/ /gzhi ru lta ba'i rmongs pa sel/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas shes na/ /thams cad chos la mkhas zhes brjod/ /zung 'jug chos kyi dbyings shes na/ /bden don mthar thug rtogs pa nyid/ /rgyu las byung ba'i 'dus byas rnams/ /skad cig gis ni mi rtag ste/ /skad cig dang po ma 'gyur na/ /mthar yang 'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /'bab chu mar me'i me sogs bzhin/ /skad cig rigs 'dra bar med la/ /byis pa rnams kyis gcig snyam nas/ /dngos po rtag par sgro 'dogs so/ /glog dang chu bur sprin sogs nas/ /lhun po'i bar gyi dngos po rnams/ /skad cig ma ru 'dra ba ste/ /'jig rgyu gzhan med ngang gis 'jig /phyi rol snod kyi 'jig rten yang*/ /sems can rnams kyi las dbang gis/ /nam mkha'i khams su sprin bzhin du/ /chags shing gnas la mthar 'jig go/ /'di ltar gnas pa'i dus nyid na'ang*/ /rkyen gyis 'phel dang 'grib pa dang*/ /las kyi snang bas 'gyur sogs kyis/ /mi rtag de yang skad cig ma/ /nang gi skye mched gzugs can rnams/ /las kyis bskyed cing rgyun gnas na'ang*/ /mngal gnas btsas pa la sogs kyi/ /gnas skabs rim par 'gyur ba nyid/ /khams gsum sems dang sems byung rnams/ /rkyen bzhi las skyes ji srid du/ /tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs kyi bar/ /skad cig ma yi phreng bar gnas/ /sa bon las ni myug sogs bzhin/ rgyu las gang skyes dngos po rnams/ /snga phyi rgyu 'bras rim skye bas/ /thams cad skad cig ma ru shes/ /dngos rnams mi rtag par shes na/ /'dus byas kun la mi chags shing*/

/rtag par 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa bral/ /yang dag don la 'jug par 'gyur/ /gang zhig zag dang bcas pa'i chos/ /sdug bsngal gsum las ma 'das te/ /skye rga na 'chi mi 'dod phrad/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal sogs/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba/ /rnam pa mang po dag dang ldan/ /gnas skabs bde ba ltar snang yang*/ /skad cig gis ni mi rtag cing*/ /tha mar rgyun yang 'gag 'gyur bas/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ /bde sdug btang snyoms kyis bsdus pa'i/ /zag bcas phung po lnga yi rgyun/ /sdug bsngal phyi ma'i rgyur gyur pas/ /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal nyid/ /de phyir 'khor ba mtha' dag kun/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin me 'obs mtshungs/ /de shes yang dag blo ldan rnams/ /srid la chags pa las grol te/ /zag med mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /zag bcas 'khor ba'i phung po'i rgyun/ /res 'ga' nyid phyir rgyu yod la/ /rgyu de'ang dbang phyug sogs min zhing*/ /las nyon yin par rigs pas mthong*/ /nyes kun rtsa ba bdag lta'i mun/ /bdag med snang bas bcom pa rnams/ /sa bon bsreg pa ji bzhin du/ /'khor bar skye ba gtan du khegs/ /'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /rang bzhin nyid la phyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /bdag med gnyis rtogs chos nyid don/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal la/ /glo bur dri ma kun bral ba'i/ /mi gnas myang 'das thar pa mchog /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas spangs pa/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gtsang ba dang*/ /yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang*/ /de rgyu log phyir bde ba nyid/ /'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid rtogs pas/ /mi gnas 'dus ma byas chen rtag /bdag dang bdag med spros pa zhi/ /chos nyid sku thob dam pa'i bdag /stobs dang dbang bcu la sogs pa/ /yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /'bras bu'i mchog la dmigs nas su/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bya/

/'dus byas 'dus ma byas chos rnams/ /brten nas skye ba'am brten nas btags/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung dbang gis ni/ /snang ba bslu med nyid yin yang*/ /ma brtags nyams dga' tsam du ste/ /rigs pas dpyad na yang dag par/ /grub pa cung zad kyang med de/ /rang rang ngo bos stong phyir ro/ /phung po'i rgyun dang tshogs pa la/ /nga'o snyam du rlom par zad/ /dpyad na phung po bdag min la/ /phung las gzhan du'ang bdag med do/ /rgyud dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ /phreng ba dmag la sogs bzhin brdzun/ /ji ltar yan lag tshogs rnams la/ /shing rta zhes su btags mod kyi/ /yan lag re re shing rta min/ /yan lag rnams las gzhan du'ang med/ /de phyir shing rtar yan lag dang*/ /yan lag la yang shing rta med/ /de gnyis phan tshun ldan ma yin/ /tshogs pa dbyibs kyang shing rta min/ /rnam pa bdun du dpyad na ma grub kyang*/ /rten 'brel dbang gis snang ba bslu med la/ /btags pa tsam gyis shing rtas 'jig rten na/ /bya ba byed pa bsnyon du mi nus ltar/ /rnam pa bdun du dpyad na bdag med kyang*/ /phung po'i rgyun dang tshogs pa la brten nas/ /ma brtags bdag go snyam pa'i blo 'byung bas/ /rnam mang bde sdug rmi lam lta bur spyod/ /gzugs ni bdag ma yin zhes gsungs te bdag /gzugs dang mi ldan gzugs la bdag yod min/ /bdag la gzugs mi gnas te de bzhin du/ /phung po lhag ma bzhi la sbyar bar bya/ /lta ri bdag med rtogs pa'i rdo rje yis/ /bcom bdag gang dang lhan cig 'jig 'gyur ba/ /'jig tshogs lta ri brtan la gnas pa yi/ /rtse mo mthor gyur nyi shu 'di dag go/ /de ltar bdag de rtag pa dang*/ /khyab dang gcig pu dbang bsgyur sogs/ /gang smras rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor te/ /gzhi med khyad chos sgro btags tsam/ /rtag na gnas skabs mi 'pho zhing*/ /gcig na khyad par sna tshogs med/ /khyab na thams cad gcig tu 'gyur/ /dbang bsgyur mi 'dod 'byung ba ci/

/de'i dngos tshad mas ma dmigs bzhin/ /de yi bde ba'i yo byad kyis/ /de sgrub 'khrul pa 'ba' zhig ste/ /mo gsham bu yi gos bzhin no/ /bdag med phung po'i rgyun tsam la/ /phan dang gnod pa bslu med phyir/ /blang dor ji bzhin byed pa ni/ /bdag med pa la shin tu rigs/ /bdag yod de la chags bral nyid/ /mi srid de phyir 'khor ba pa/ /bdag med chags pa kun bral te/ /thar pa'i nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang zag dag tu sgro 'dogs pa'i/ /gdags gzhi phung sogs kyis mtshon pas/ /phyi nang 'khor 'das chos kun kyang*/ /rang bzhin med de ji ltar na/ /sgyu ma rmi lam gzugs brnyan dang*/ /smig rgyu dang ni chu'i zla ba/ /mig yor brag cha sprul pa ste/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dag dang mtshungs/ /rten 'brel dbang gis snang ba 'dir/ /snang gzhi phra rab gnyis dag gam/ /gzhan dbang shes pa mi stong sogs/ /'dod pa dbu ma'i lam las gol/ /gang yang dpyad bzod mi 'grub pas/ /rang gi ngo bos mi stong pa/ /cung zad med kyang stong bzhin du/ /snang ba chos nyid rig pas shes/ /gal te bdag las bdag skye na/ /skye ba don med thug med 'gyur/ /gzhan las gzhan dag 'byung na yang*/ /kun las kun kyang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnyis ka las ni skye ba la/ /phyogs gnyis brjod pa'i skyon gyis gnod/ /rgyu med gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur/ /chos gang skye ba ma dmigs na/ /gnas pa la sogs ga la yod/ /skye 'gag sogs su snang ba ni/ /ma brtags tha snyad tsam du 'dod/ /gal te skye ba dmigs na ni/ /tha snyad bden pa dpyad bzod dang*/ /don dam skye ba mi khegs dang*/ /'phags lam dngos po'i 'jig rgyur 'gyur/ /de phyir gdod nas ma skyes kyang*/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul mi 'gag pa/ /skye dang skye med mnyam pa'i don/ /dbu ma'i lam gyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /du mas 'bras bu gcig skyed na/ /gcig dang tha dad rgyu med 'gyur/

/du mas du ma skyed pa na/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo gcig mi srid/ /gcig gis du ma skyed pa na/ /tha dad 'bras bu mi srid 'gyur/ /gcig gis gcig pu skyed pa na/ /rgyu tshogs pa la dgos med 'gyur/ /de phyir rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'dir/ /gcig bden bral phyir tha dad med/ /gcig dang tha dad btags tsam las/ /yang dag don la skye ba med/ /'bras bu yod na rgyu mi dgos/ /med na rgyu yis bskyed mi nus/ /gnyis yin gnyis min mi srid pas/ /dpyad na skye ba mi 'grub bo/ /de bzhin skye dang 'gag pa dang*/ /gnas dang mi gnas bdag yod med/ /ngo bos ma grub btags pa tsam/ /gang yang dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /'di zhes khas len med pa la/ /byis pa rnams ni skrag mod kyi/ /so so rang rig tha snyad bral/ /spros bral mthong rnams yid ches so/ /drug gis gcig char sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag ni go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ /de phyir gzugs can thams cad ni/ /yan lag tshogs par bshig nas su/ /phra ba'i rdul kyang mi 'grub pa/ /de la dngos po ji ltar yod/ /skad cig snga phyi'i cha can phyir/ /dbus kyi skad cig cha bcas 'gyur/ /de la cha shas med gyur na/ /bskal pa'ang skad cig tsam du 'gyur/ /de ltar dpyad na rdul dang ni/ /dus mtha'i cha med mi 'grub pas/ /dngos po rnams kyi rtsom gzhi zhig /bden grub 'dod pa kun brtags tsam/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad snang ba yang*/ /rkyen las byung zhing mi rtag la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs cha bcas pas/ /gcig pur bden pa gang yang med/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis stong shes pa yang*/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub ste/ /dmigs su rung na gcig bden med/ /mi rung ba la sgrub byed bral/ /de phyir gzhan dbang rnam shes nyid/ /bden grub 'dod pa'ang kun brtags te/ /rten 'byung dbang gis gang snang rnams/ /ngo bos bden pa mi srid do/

/ldan min gnas skabs btags pa tsam/ /'dus ma byas kyang ngo bos dben/ /de phyir 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /gang la'ang gcig bden mi 'grub bo/ /gcig med phyir na du ma med/ /gcig dang du mar med gyur na/ /rnam pa gzhan du bden pa zhig /mi srid phung gsum med phyir ro/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /rgyu dang rkyen las gang snang ba// rang gi ngo bos ma grub ste/ /bcos ma gzugs brnyan lta bu nyid/ /snang yang bden par ma grub pas/ /rtag chad skye 'gag la sogs bral/ /stong dang rten 'byung 'bral med la/ /tha snyad thams cad rung ba nyid/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni/ /dbu ma'i lam gyis rtogs bya ste/ /snang stong gnyis med mnyam pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes mthar thug don/ /bsam brjod bral ba'i de kho na/ /so so rang gis rig bya'o/ /gang gis yang dag don 'di rtogs/ /de yis theg pa chen po yi/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan kun/ /ji bzhin nges par 'grub pa yin/ /de ltar zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /shes bya'i don la ma rmongs shing*/ /blo ldan dam chos 'dzin pa des/ /mdo sogs chos kyi rnam grangs 'chad/ /mdo sde dbyangs snyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gling gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*/ /skyes rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /'di dag gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste/ /rjod byed sde snod gsum zhes bya/ /de yis brjod bya bslab pa gsum/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bo/ /de dag theg pa chung ngu dang*/ /chen po gnyis kyi rnam par dbye/ /de la thos bsam sgom pa yis/ /khams brtas don rtogs grol bar byed/ /ming don ngo bo khyad par du/ /'dogs pa'i kun tu tshol ba bzhi/ /rtsa ba'i sems dang rab dbye dang*/ /don dang nges 'dzin bsdom pa dang*/ /smon pa'i sems ni rnam drug gis/ /chos kyi don la yongs su 'jug

/rtog dpyod bcas dang dpyod pa dang*/ /rtog dpyod gnyis bral tshul gyis ni/ /zhi lhag zung du 'jug gsum gyis/ /chos kyi dmigs pa tshol bar bya/ /rtogs nas gzhan la smra ba na/ /yi ge ming dang tshig gi lam/ /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum/ /de las rtsom te rjod byed des/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed yi ge'i tshogs/ /sngon rjes ming gzhi'i 'jug pa rnams/ /'dus las ming 'byung de la yang*/ /'dod rgyal rjes grub sogs su dbye/ /chos dngos las dang byed pa dang*/ /ched don 'byung khungs 'brel pa dang*/ /rten gnas bod pa rnam dbye brgyad/ /gzhan yang lhag bcas sgra sogs so/ /las 'dzin pa gnyis grangs med pa/ /'bru mang po dang de'i skyes bu/ /zlas dbye zhes bya tshig sdud drug /de sogs sgra yi mtshan nyid shes/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i rang bzhin dag /yid 'phrog rgyan gyi nyams ldan zhing*/ /don gsal tshang zhing nges pa yi/ /tshul gyis smra ba'i dbang phyug thob/ /bden gnyis dpyod pa'i tshad ma gnyis/ /dbye na bya ba byed pa dang*/ /ltos pa chos nyid 'thad sgrub kyi/ /rigs pa rnam pa bzhi zhes gsungs/ /dbang po yid dang rang rig dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum rnam pa bzhi/ /phyogs chos rjes 'gro ldog khyab la/ /tshul gsum zhes bya de tshang na/ /yang dag rtags yin gzhan ltar snang*/ /de yang rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 'byin pa/ /ltar snang bcas pa gzhan go byed/ /'bras bu rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i/ /rtags gsum nang gi dbye ba bcas/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi ni gang zhig la/ /smra ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa yis/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin legs smras pa/ /'bel ba'i gtam gyis don gsal byed/ /de ltar rigs pas tshul bzhin du/ /nges las rton pa bzhi 'byung zhing*/ /gsung rab rnams kyi dgongs don la/ /drang nges legs par phye ba yis/

/ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi/ /mun pa rnam par bsal byas nas/ /ye shes snang ba rab rgyas pas/ /spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad grol te/ /dran dang blo gros rtogs pa dang*/ /gzungs spobs chos dang byang chub sems/ /sgrub pa brgyad ldan skyes bu de'i/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i chos mdzod la mkhas phyir/ /sdom byang 'di nyid legs par sbyar//'di yi dge bas 'gro kun gyis/ /zab rgyas shes rab thob par shog/ces pa'ang mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pas bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// //
